description: Sol rounds 8 and 9 BLOCK: a sibling inserted before the inert button B on reload shifts its positional selector onto another button. The probe never clicks an element other than the one it captured, found again uniquely at the same place; here the selector lands elsewhere (relocated), so nothing is clicked and the declared-actions check is inconclusive, never passed.
